answer: When one mind wears many masks, its agents betray a shared harbor: the capital flows and invite edges that spawned them trace to a common origin. A sybil-resistant ledger scores each identity by funding-path independence, so two agents fed from the same wallet or vouched along the same invite edge get rewards blended and their pigment of distinctness washed out. To forge N independent actors the attacker must arrange N genuinely unlinkable capital sources and disjoint social edges, each a separate ember of real cost, so the cheap copy-paste swarm collapses into a single accountable node.
